what: Commit subcommand only copies the staged log-root tree; it never ingests per-run tmpdir breadcrumb NDJSON
scenario_or_breakage: The plan extends commit to walk $RUN_DIR/breadcrumbs/, but breadcrumbs live under $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ (or $DESIGN_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/) until explicitly written; commit never reads skill tmpdirs, so committed larch-logs/<run-id>/breadcrumbs/ stays empty despite non-empty tmpdir streams
suggested_fix: Add a write --batch breadcrumbs --input-dir <tmpdir>/breadcrumbs branch (per prior design wire format), call it from design-log-publish.sh, refresh-run-logs.sh, and implement Step 7a/flush paths before commit; keep commit as a git staging step only
